title: OmniEarth-Bench: Towards Holistic Evaluation of Earth’s Six Spheres and Cross-Spheres Interactions with Multimodal Observational Earth Data
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the geoscientific reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models. While it includes a standard section on potential societal impact and safety risks in the appendix, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, ethics, or morals.
